title: A Compass for the Regiment
author: Tamsin Lockridge
blurb: Emrys Dravenmoor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
